description: Issue-search relevance fixture (cond-0633, design section 16.1). Every case is grounded in snapshot snap-40511acc9849; duplicate-pair labels use only relations the snapshot itself records as confirmed duplicates, and every pair was read and verified by a human-lane reviewer before inclusion. Queries derived verbatim from corpus text carry derivation=verbatim or derivation=comment; natural-language paraphrases carry derivation=paraphrase and are deliberately worded to avoid copying distinctive issue strings.

cases.query: conduct deploy --dry-run --bounce
cases.notes: The live open report (cond-0376) and the canonical closed report (cond-0087) are the targets; the duplicate cluster and the separately-fixed cond-0387 are acceptable. Other bounce failure modes (stdout capture, daemon-log marker reuse, launchd race, foreign log misattribution) are related-but-distinct hard negatives.

cases.query: guarded bounce returned no verified activation receipt
cases.notes: Baseline-hostile: in the canonical issue cond-0087 the phrase is line-wrapped inside the stored body ('activation\nreceipt'), so a literal %substring% ILIKE cannot match it there. The fragment does occur unwrapped in the cluster siblings and in both revision-stamped reports. Exercises the tokenization weakness design section 10.3 lane 3 exists for.

cases.query: conduct review history --project cao-final-gate --pr 35
cases.notes: Canonical review-history issue plus its nine confirmed duplicates. The test is whether the canonical target is findable inside a tight near-identical duplicate cluster.

cases.query: TerminalInputBlockedError
cases.notes: Symbol unique to cond-0035's body. cond-0034 is the adjacent steer-input journaling defect (crash window) and must not outrank the symbol's owner.

cases.query: _codex_mcp_pin_preflight
cases.notes: Underscored symbol. Legacy SQL LIKE treats each underscore as a single-char wildcard, so the baseline matches loosely; a correct exact lane should pin the owning issue. cond-0011 is the unrelated codex profile defect.

cases.query: conduct/commands/deploy.py
cases.notes: Path fingerprint. cond-0387's resolution cites the exact fix site (conduct/commands/deploy.py:3121); cond-0311/cond-0331 are deploy/cutover defects citing the same module. cond-0469 merely mentions the path in an unrelated retained-v1 inventory defect and must not outrank the deploy issues.

cases.query: spawned agent fails to load its behaviour guidance document at startup
cases.notes: Paraphrase of the worker-conduct-skill-unreadable cluster; deliberately shares almost no surface tokens with the issues.

cases.query: supervisor stays parked forever after a worker finishes because nothing wakes it up
cases.notes: Paraphrase of the registered-trigger/wake-gap family.

cases.query: first-use domain proof refuses because no prior record exists and the error suggests running the same proof again
cases.notes: Paraphrase of the launch-domain attestation self-recommendation cluster.

cases.query: collection rejects a finished pull request because its target branch was corrected to a different integration base
cases.notes: Paraphrase of the immutable collect base binding defect.

cases.query: recovery command silently refuses long operation identifiers above an undocumented length cap
cases.notes: Paraphrase of the 55-character unstick operation-id limit.

cases.query: health check passes by matching an old log file left by the previous installation
cases.notes: Paraphrase of the doctor stale-log satisfaction defect; target is a terminal (closed) issue, exercising terminal-candidate retrieval.

cases.query: guarded bounce falsely fails activation-receipt gate
cases.notes: Query is the duplicate's own wording (cond-0335 title). Confirmed relation: cond-0335 duplicate_of cond-0087 in the snapshot. The canonical target must be reachable from the duplicate's phrasing.

cases.query: documented review-history query is not installed
cases.notes: Query is duplicate cond-0136's title; confirmed relation cond-0136 duplicate_of cond-0150. Canonical must surface from the duplicate's phrasing.

cases.query: callback adjudication ends before successor dispatch and leaves no wake
cases.notes: Query is duplicate cond-0237's title; confirmed relation cond-0237 duplicate_of cond-0213.

cases.query: Patch or pin compatible pyte behavior and add a StatusMonitor-level regression
cases.notes: Decision-bearing (important-role) comment: the disposition verdict exists only in a progress comment, in no issue field. The legacy lane cannot search comments at all, so this measures the comment-document lane's reason to exist. comment_role=important per design section 6.2 semantics.

cases.query: failed-job rerun completed green
cases.notes: Routine progress comment (rerun report) matching only in comment text; comment_role=routine. An ordinary comment hit should rank below an important one under issue-level fusion once lanes exist.

cases.query: argument command: invalid choice: review
cases.notes: CLI error fragment captured only inside an evidence comment on the canonical review-history issue.

cases.query: activation receipt
cases.notes: Two-token contiguous phrase matching the bounce family across statuses: the top-10 must contain at least one OPEN and at least one TERMINAL relevant candidate, because searches cover open and terminal issues (design section 16.1). The open_terminal_mix metric is only computed for status-mix cases.

cases.query: code intelligence and issue-triage guidance for repository agents
cases.notes: aegix-0001 and dnd-0001 are near-identical onboarding issues in different tracker projects; a natural hard-negative pair. Scoped to aegix, the quest-scheduler twin must not appear.

cases.query: code intelligence and issue-triage guidance for repository agents
cases.notes: Mirror of the aegix scope case.

cases.query: code intelligence and issue-triage guidance for repository agents
cases.notes: Installation-wide retrieval (explicit opt-in, design section 10.1): both onboarding issues are relevant.

cases.query: relevance fixture and metrics harness
cases.notes: Subtree root cond-0628 closure (cond-0628, cond-0633..cond-0635, cond-0683) constrains the ranked request (design section 10.1). cond-0634 is the sibling code-grounding lane and must not outrank the relevance-fixture issue.

Observed-revision fingerprint: the installed conductor head cited in cond-0387's reproduction. The report matching the queried revision is the expected result, not the same-defect reports filed against other revisions.
